q: How much does a website cost?
a: It depends on what the site needs to do. A focused landing page costs a fraction of a full corporate website. After a short call we'll give you one fixed quote, no hourly billing, no surprise line items halfway through.

A landing page typically ships in 1–2 weeks. A full website usually takes 3–6 weeks depending on the number of pages and how quickly content is approved. We agree on the timeline before we start, and we keep to it.

q: Where are you based, and how does remote work?
a: We're based on Ayala Avenue in Makati (Philippines), and the team is remote-first. Everything, calls, reviews, delivery, happens online, so your timezone is never a problem.
We don't disappear. Every project includes a support period for fixes and tweaks, and most clients continue with us for updates, content or growth campaigns. You choose the level of involvement.
Completely. The domain, the design, the code and the content are 100% yours. If you ever want to move to another provider, everything comes with you.

q: Can you work with my existing brand?
a: Of course. If you have a logo and brand guidelines, we design within them. If your brand needs a refresh first, we'll tell you honestly and can handle that too.
Book a free strategy call. In 30 minutes we'll understand your goals, tell you what we'd recommend, and give you a clear quote. No pressure, no obligation. If we're not the right fit, we'll say so.

q: Do you work with clients outside the US and Philippines?
a: Yes. We're remote-first and work with founders worldwide. Our US and Philippines hubs are home base, not a boundary. Wherever you are, the process is the same.

q: Do you charge a fixed price or a monthly retainer?
a: Project work, a website, a brand, an MVP, is quoted as one fixed price agreed up front. Ongoing work like ads, SEO or social runs on a clear monthly scope. Either way you know the number before we start; there's no hourly billing.

q: Can I hire you for just one thing, or do I need the whole package?
a: One thing is fine. Take a single service or a single stage, brand, a landing page, a growth campaign, or run the full lifecycle with one team. We scope to what you actually need, not a bundle.

q: What if I already have an in-house team or developer?
a: We slot in around them. We can own a specific stage, fill a gap your team doesn't cover, and hand everything off cleanly so your people can keep building. You own the code and accounts throughout.

q: Can you take over a project another agency or freelancer started?
a: Usually, yes. We'll review what exists, tell you honestly what's worth keeping and what isn't, and pick it up from there rather than forcing a restart you don't need.

q: Who will I actually be working with?
a: The people building your project, not an account manager relaying messages. You get a direct line to the team doing the work, which is how decisions get made in hours instead of weeks.
